title: Production Monitoring Exercise
prompt: Track client errors and a defined set of performance indicators.

starter.code:
// Task: Track client errors and a defined set of performance indicators.
// TODO: implement the behavior and add a focused test.

public_tests.name: Required source markers
public_tests.description: A static token grader checks that the submission contains these markers; it is not a compiler or runtime test.

public_tests.name: Behavior and edge-case review
public_tests.description: Demonstrate expected behavior plus one relevant failure or boundary case.

acceptance_criteria: The learner documents a small set of useful metrics, privacy considerations and alert thresholds.
Add a focused test or written verification note for one edge case.
Document the Angular/Node/API assumptions; do not claim the static grader executed the code.
hints: Start from the required API marker `LCP` and name the intended behavior.
Use the smallest component, service or template necessary; keep backend-owned business rules on the server.
Run the relevant `ng test` or project tests locally, and verify an error or empty state.
grading_method: Server-side static token check for required text plus learner-provided tests/evidence for human review. It does not compile or execute Angular source.
retry_policy: Practice retries are allowed; platform completion and reward idempotency are handled by the backend, not course-authored fields.
status_note: Draft until the instructions, starter and static grader are reviewed against a pinned Angular version.
